patch_description: Replace the reverse-chain CRZ gates with alternating CRX gates using parameters "crx_rev_a" on odd-indexed links (7-6, 5-4, 3-2, 1-0) and "crx_rev_b" on even-indexed links (6-5, 4-3, 2-1). This maintains the exact gate count and alternating parameter sharing pattern from Program 2 while exploring X-axis entanglement, which is orthogonal to the existing Z-axis phase correlations. This should preserve fast convergence (150 steps) while potentially improving expressivity through axis diversity.
